description: Shared test vectors of coordinator request signing: JWS (RFC 7515) compact serialization, alg Ed25519 (RFC 9864, RFC 8032), the payload protocol.SignedInferenceRequest. The same file is in darkbloom-platform (coordinator/tests/protocol/testdata/request-signing-vectors.json) and d-inference; each repo's CI rebuilds it from its live types and compares. Each frame vector is an inference_request as the provider receives it; the verifier block is the provider build that checks it.
test_keys_only: TEST VECTORS ONLY. Every key here is a published RFC 8032 section 7.1 test key. No build may pin one.

payload_mutation.rule: flip the low bit of each byte of the decoded payload in turn, re-encode it, keep the header and signature

frames.name: minimal
frames.description: The fields every dispatch carries.

frames.name: every_field
frames.description: Every field of the payload set; cache_repeated_prefix_tokens is a present 0 (novel fleet-wide), not absent.

frames.name: fresh_just_inside_past
frames.description: issued_at_ms 299 999 ms before the verifier's clock.

frames.name: fresh_just_inside_future
frames.description: issued_at_ms 299 999 ms after the verifier's clock.

frames.name: stale_at_bound
frames.description: issued_at_ms exactly 300 s before the verifier's clock: the bound is strict.

frames.name: future_at_bound
frames.description: issued_at_ms exactly 300 s after the verifier's clock.

frames.name: wrong_recipient

frames.name: json_serialization

frames.name: s_at_least_l

frames.name: truncated_signature
frames.description: The signature cut to 63 bytes.

frames.name: v1_signature_only
frames.description: A deleted v1 coordinator_signature that is valid (master's v1 statement, RequestSignatureStatement at origin/master, signed by the pinned key; v1_statement_hex holds its bytes) and no signed_request: a pinned build ignores the v1 field, so a build that requires signatures refuses it (T11).
